claim: At 0.8.0 the native XAX server drives a native XAX compiler rebuilt from the pinned tree over MCP STDIO through the whole prototype chain: it describes the current store, resolves and builds it, applies one XAXEDIT1 transaction, rebuilds the edited store, and executes the artifact in the native Windows confinement, which exits 41.
label: EXECUTED
scope: one seed program, one constant mutation, one host and one locally rebuilt compiler; not a general construct/build/execute loop
supersedes_nothing: This is a new file appended to the record. It does not edit docs/evidence/native-windows-x86_64-build-3e9b0c2.json, which recorded the earlier suite run with XAX_MCP_TEST_COMPILER unset.

limits: The compiler is a local rebuild outside the pinned XAX tree; a reproducible committed native compiler is still upstream work (B1). The build bootstrap that produced it is Python, disclosed and off the request path.

Only query(root), resolve+build of the current store, one XAXEDIT1 edit, a rebuild and execute are exercised; workspace handles, typed mutations, expected-generation checks, pagination and construct do not have a native chain test.
The artifact is the seed's tiny program; the edit changes one constant. This is not evidence of a general construct/build/execute loop and does not make the carrier authors (B5) native.
The Windows executor is the measured prototype described in docs/NATIVE.md; this run exercised it but is not a security review.
claim_text: On 2026-10-22, the 0.8.0 native server (store root 18ceecd9..., artifact SHA-256 9f6e272b...) drove a native XAX compiler rebuilt from the 3e9b0c2 tree through query, resolve+build, one XAXEDIT1 transaction, a second build and xax_execute over STDIO on Windows 11 x86-64. The executed artifact exited 41 with empty stdout/stderr, matching the 40 -> 41 constant edit, and the server exited cleanly. The compiler is not committed (B1); neither the compiler nor the carrier decoder is shipped, and no Python is imported by or launched by the server.
